draft.text: You came in because you have been having acid reflux symptoms for many years, and they have gotten worse over time.
You feel a burning in your chest and throat, especially after eating spicy foods, soda, citrus, or tomato-based foods, and when you are stressed at work.
We did not do any tests or exams during this visit.
You have a history of acid reflux, and you have tried medicines like omeprazole and ranitidine before, which helped a little.
You also mentioned that your appetite has been off, which is new.
You will be asked to keep a food diary to track what you eat and how you feel.
We will talk about your progress and any changes to your treatment plan at your next visit.

unverified_summary.text: You came in because you have had acid reflux symptoms since you were 12 years old, and they have gotten worse over the past few years.
We found that your symptoms include a burning feeling in your chest and throat.
These are often caused by certain foods like spicy items, soda, citrus, or tomato-based foods, and also by stress at work.
You have a history of acid reflux, and you have tried medicines like omeprazole and ranitidine before, which helped a little.
You do not have trouble swallowing, regurgitation, or unexpected weight loss.
You will be referred for an upper endoscopy to look inside your esophagus and stomach to check for any issues.
You will also keep a food diary to track what makes your symptoms worse.
You will start taking a proton pump inhibitor to help with your symptoms.
We will see you again to check how you are doing and make any changes to your treatment if needed.
